title: Python While Loops

Python
While Loops



Python Loops

Python has two primitive loop commands:

while
loops

for
loops

The while Loop

With the
while
loop we can execute a set of statements as long as a condition is true.

Note:
remember to increment i, or else the loop will continue forever.

The
while
loop requires relevant variables to be ready, in this example we need to define an indexing variable,
i
,
which we set to 1.

break

continue

else
